Name: Elven Krobus
Author: MelNoelle
Description:
{Note! I designed this mod to go with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3070]Underdark Sewer mod[/url], but left them separate so people choose to have one OR both!}

Become friends with Krobus, the shadow elf who has left his home caverns deep underground to hide away in the sewers below town!

With this mod, Krobus is now an elf - a drow elf by default, fitting with the underground, can't-go-outside, cave-dwelling theme - and has new dialogue! Though the drow fit best with the lore without changing too much, included are many different skin/hair coloring options to choose from too!

How to install:
[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip Elven Krobus file!
[*]Find the two folders - ﻿[CP] Elven Krobus & ElvenKrobus - and put both mods (keep them separate) into your MODS folder!
This is how your file tree should look:
Stardew Valley -> Mods -> [CP] Elven Krobus / ElvenKrobus
[/list]
Inside the [CP] Elven Krobus folder, there's a config file you can open and edit to change the appearance of Krobus! Here are all the options:
[list]
[*]Drowelf - the default, a typical drow, white hair, red eyes, gray skin.
[*]Purpledrow - Drow with white hair, purple eyes and skin.
[*]Bluedrow - Drow with white hair, yellow eyes, dark blue skin.
[*]Browndrow - Drow with white hair, red eyes, dark brown skin.
[*]Albino - Pale gold hair, pink eyes, pale skin.
[*]Brown - Brown hair and eyes, cream skin.
[*]Darkbrown - Brown hair and eyes, darker brown skin.
[*]Darkerbrown - Black hair and eyes, dark brown skin.
[*]Moss - Green hair and eyes, cream skin.
[*]Vampire - Black hair, red eyes, and white skin.
[*]Redhead - Red hair, green eyes, pink skin.
[/list]
Notes!
[list]
[*]This mod keeps the shadow creature sprite for the winter event, since I personally like the idea that it's another creature and not Krobus, even though they use the same spritesheet.
[*]ALSO, the dialogue is currently only available in English. If you'd like to translate into another language, please let me know! I'll update with your translation and give you credit here!
[*]THANK YOU to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26588659?tab=user+files]Kirbylink [/url]for writing the code for me to make Krobus taller & editing the events to reference the right sprites![url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/26588659?tab=user+files] Go check out his mods[/url]! He's thinking about making a toolkit for modders soon, a template for a taller (16x32 instead of the current 16x24) Krobus and Dwarf, so keep your eye out for that!
[/list]
Future updates, the top three being in the works:
[list]
[*]More portrait emotion options, like with other NPCs
[*]Female version
[*]Expanded dialogue (Currently there is only dialogue for every week/heart level, but not for all 4 seasons)
[*]If [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3054]Looking for Love (Siv's Marriage Mod)[/url]﻿ grows to include Krobus, then make compatible marriage dialogue
[*]If CustomNPC is updated, I would like to switch over to that and make this elf a new character, complete with heart events and schedule changes

[/list]
